description: A black USB hub sits on the green bedspread with a long cable snaking across the bed, and a purple pillow is propped up behind it. The left hand steadies the hub near its ports while the right hand reaches in from the right, grips a USB plug, and guides it downward into an open port; both hands briefly hold the plug area to seat it firmly, then the right hand releases and lifts away while the left hand lets go.
